notes.title: Patch Notes (v0.24)
notes.content:
Check out the changes below:

- Mussa's visuals have been updated
- Added difficulty modes (easy, normal and hard)
- Minor improvements, general adjustments and corrections

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32518405/2d26a2e695bf3d18d4ea2c9f9753a042d483db8d.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.23 (achievements)
notes.content:
We have just released version 0.23 bringing stats and achievements to the game! There are up to 53 achievements planed to the full game while in the current version 51 are already available!

We hope you have fun unlocking all the available achievements, and please, share your feedback on how is the difficulty to get them.

Soon we are going to uploading final arts for all the achievements.

notes.title: Patch Note - 0.17.2
notes.content:
We have just released another minor game update concerning gameplay adjustments and minor bug fixes. 

More details:
- Game difficulty adjustments on the levels: 4, 7 and 8.
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.17
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32518405/01e21c6fe983bbdd62f6322fb7a0252998621a30.png[/img]

The update is focused in reducing game difficulty. A checkpoint is now added to each game level and areas of tension were adjusted to become easier to pass.

Patch Notes
- Checkpoints added to the game levels
- Adjustment to character movement and jumping
- Game levels adjustments
- Some enemies were removed from a variety of levels

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.16.1
notes.content:
- The player now earns extra lives collecting hearts when already having 5 hearts
- Removed character movement deceleration when no movement input is present
